textbookBox.concept: To locate a point in a plane we use two perpendicular lines: a horizontal x-axis and a vertical y-axis, meeting at the origin O with coordinates (0, 0).

beats.en: To locate a point in a plane we use two perpendicular lines: a horizontal x-axis and a vertical y-axis, meeting at the origin O with coordinates (0, 0).
beats.speakEn: To locate a point in a plane we use two perpendicular lines: a horizontal x-axis and a vertical y-axis, meeting at the origin O with coordinates (0, 0).

beats.en: The distance of a point from the y-axis is its x-coordinate, and the distance from the x-axis is its y-coordinate, written as the ordered pair (x, y).
beats.speakEn: The distance of a point from the y-axis is its x-coordinate, and the distance from the x-axis is its y-coordinate, written as the ordered pair (x, y).

textbookBox.concept: A point on the x-axis has the form (x, 0), and a point on the y-axis has the form (0, y).

beats.en: A point on the x-axis has the form (x, 0), and a point on the y-axis has the form (0, y).
beats.speakEn: A point on the x-axis has the form (x, 0), and a point on the y-axis has the form (0, y).

beats.en: The axes divide the plane into four quadrants. The signs are (+, +) in Quadrant I, (-, +) in II, (-, -) in III and (+, -) in IV.
beats.speakEn: The axes divide the plane into four quadrants. The signs are (+, +) in Quadrant I, (-, +) in II, (-, -) in III and (+, -) in IV.
